comment: ETP HTCondor adapter settings (MAC_OVERNIGHT_RUNBOOK_20261113 Unit 2; cluster runbook HTCONDOR_PREP_RUNBOOK_20261114 §0.3/§0.4). Every value carries a status: 'ruled: <source>' (decided by the author or a PLAN row), 'measured: <source>' (observed on the pool), or 'proposed: <source>' (taken from the ETP wiki as quoted in the cluster runbook, or a default chosen here; not yet confirmed by the cluster agent's report). Change a value only with its status. AI-assisted (Claude, Mac-local agent, 14 Nov 2026).

real_submission_enabled.status: ruled: MAC_OVERNIGHT_RUNBOOK_20261113 Unit 2 (defaults to false; enable only after a reviewed probe)

max_transfer_input_mb.status: proposed: ETP wiki via HTCONDOR_PREP_RUNBOOK §0.3 (HTCondor file transfer only under 100 MB; larger data via /ceph or xrootd)

max_gpus.status: proposed: ETP wiki via HTCONDOR_PREP_RUNBOOK §0.3 (request_GPUs up to 8)

max_walltime_s.status: proposed: Mac agent default (24 h); the cluster report should measure site limits

gpu_device_names.status: proposed: ETP wiki via HTCONDOR_PREP_RUNBOOK §0.3/§4.1 (exact GPUs_DeviceName strings; the V100 32 GB string is a guess until POOL_FACTS.md lists the slots' names)

cloud_sites.status: proposed: ETP wiki via HTCONDOR_PREP_RUNBOOK §0.3 (TARGET.CloudSite for NEMO2)

accounting_groups.status: proposed: ETP wiki via HTCONDOR_PREP_RUNBOOK §0.3; which one (if any) the author uses is open (§0.4 A)

trackp_gpu_device_names.status: ruled: author Q-TORCH 15 Nov 2026 (no V100S for Track P; L40S/H200 only)

max_image_disk_kb.status: proposed: cluster agent 15 Nov 2026 (container-universe image-transfer cap; S5 measured the pulled v1 gpu image at ~11 GB EP-side, so 40,000,000 kB leaves room for the sandbox and a larger future image)

image_disk_margin_kb.status: proposed: cluster agent 15 Nov 2026 (headroom added on top of 2 x the measured image footprint inside request_disk; the EP cache can hold the pulled image and the job's copy; S5 measured the image plus sandbox)

runner_timeout_margin_s.status: proposed: Mac agent (a Track G job's walltime must exceed the runner's own timeout plus this margin, so the runner's timeout fires before an HTCondor walltime hold; review S8)
